scenario.opening:
Morning light comes through the gaps in the plywood in thin gold stripes. Marlene is already up, counting cans in the stockroom for the third time this week and writing the number on the wall in marker. Four days, the number says.

Dex paces the sales floor with the shotgun, checking the windows that don't need checking. Ruth sits cross-legged on the floor beside a disassembled generator, sleeves pushed up, not talking to anyone. Gil Ferris, who owns this place and won't let anyone forget it, has the office door shut again.

"Herd's still coming," Dex says to no one in particular. "Saw it from the roof at dawn. Maybe a day out."

Marlene looks up from her cans and meets your eyes, like she's waiting to hear what you think.

characterData.name: Jordan Pike
characterData.want: keep this group alive long enough to find somewhere safer
characterData.voice: Few words, dry humor, calm under pressure.
characterData.description: Drove the same county routes for ten years and knows every back road. Ended up at Harmon's by chance and stayed because someone had to keep things steady.
characterData.appearance: Medium build in a faded courier jacket, with short dark hair, a road-map tattoo on one forearm and a crowbar never far from reach.
knows: Gil Ferris keeps the office locked even at night and gets defensive when anyone goes near it.

characterData.name: Marlene Ortiz
characterData.want: keep everyone fed and together, and never abandon anyone again
characterData.secret: On day nine she left her previous group behind during an overrun to save herself. She tells people she was the only survivor.
characterData.voice: Calm and warm, calls people 'honey', goes cold when angry.
characterData.description: Thirty years in an emergency room left her calm in a crisis and impossible to fool about a wound. She keeps the food count and everyone's spirits.
characterData.appearance: Short and solid, with silver hair pinned up, reading glasses on a cord and a nurse's watch she still checks out of habit.

agenda.goal: stretch the food so nobody has to be left behind
steps: recounts the stockroom shelves and rewrites the ration chart
sets aside a hidden emergency bag for the weakest of the group

steps.text: comes to Jordan with the real numbers and a hard proposal

knows: The food count on the wall assumes Gil isn't eating from somewhere else, and she's starting to doubt that.

characterData.name: Dex Coleman
characterData.want: get to his sister's last known location in the next county
characterData.secret: Two days ago something scratched his forearm during a supply run. He wrapped it and tells himself it was broken glass.
characterData.voice: Loud, quick, military slang, jokes when scared.
characterData.description: Army reserve, two weekends a month, until the world ended. Brave, loud and loyal; the one who stands watch without being asked.
characterData.appearance: Broad-shouldered with a buzz cut and an old unit T-shirt, a shotgun on a sling and dirt ground into his boots.

agenda.goal: hide how bad the wound is getting
steps: rewraps his forearm alone and swallows the last painkillers
scouts the route toward the county line from the roof

steps.text: comes to Jordan asking to take the pickup out alone

knows: The wound under his bandage is hot to the touch this morning.

characterData.name: Ruth Han
characterData.want: get out of this town for good
characterData.secret: She fixed a handheld radio and heard a rescue convoy broadcast heading to a coastal safe zone. It said they can only take three more people. She hasn't told anyone.
characterData.voice: Short sentences, long silences, rarely smiles.
characterData.description: A mechanic who would rather fix things than talk about them. Keeps to herself and her toolbox, and notices more than she says.
characterData.appearance: Lean, with black hair tied back under a bandana, oil-stained overalls and a socket wrench in her back pocket.

agenda.goal: get a seat on the convoy
steps: listens to the convoy broadcast again and notes the pickup time
works on the pickup in the lot, looking for a way to start it without keys

steps.text: comes to Jordan to sound them out about leaving with her

knows: The convoy broadcast said it would pass the highway junction in about two days.

characterData.name: Gil Ferris
characterData.want: keep control of his store and come out of this with something left
characterData.secret: He has a hidden stash of canned food and the keys to the pickup in the lot, locked in his office desk.
characterData.voice: Gruff, folksy, reminds everyone whose store this is.
characterData.description: Owns Harmon's Hardware, inherited from his father, and treats the store like the last thing he has. Shrewd, folksy and wary of everyone in it.
characterData.appearance: Heavyset, with a grey moustache, a faded store-logo cap and a ring of store keys on his belt that jingles when he walks.

agenda.goal: stay in charge of the store and what is in it
steps: moves part of his stash into a crawlspace behind the office
makes a quiet deal with whoever seems most useful to him
starts setting new rules for who gets to go into the stockroom

knows: He saw Dex flinch and hide his arm when Marlene offered to change the bandage.
